title: The Kaspar Hauser Mystery
hook: A boy with no memory, found in 1828, has baffled historians for nearly two centuries.

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In 1828, a boy named Kaspar Hauser was found in Nuremberg, his origins a mystery.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: Investigators noted he had no memory, but possessed a German accent.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: A letter found in his hand claimed he had been raised in a secluded house.

beats.label: CLUE 3
beats.line: The letter mentioned a secret society, but no records exist.

beats.label: THEORY
beats.line: Some theorists suggest he was a political pawn, others a fabricated persona.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: A 2023 forensic analysis indicated markings of a cowpox vaccination, not DNA matching a known German family.

end.line: What could Kaspar's true story be?

description: A brief case file on the enigmatic Kaspar Hauser.
